def_en: 1) not, no, nor, neither, nothing (as wish or preference)
1a) do not, let not (with a verb)
1b) let there not be (with a verb understood)
kjv: nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.
expl: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
